source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U04: Distinguish hypothecation, pledge and the section31 exclusion

facts.locator: printed p.252 / PDF p.271; existing primary selected-text record
facts.statement: Hypothecation is the described charge on existing/future movable property without delivery, including floating charge/crystallisation. Section31(b) excludes pledge of movables within Contract Act172 from Act application.

payload.title: Possession and the statutory exclusion matter
payload.core_explanation_md:
Hypothecation describes the specified charge over existing or future movable property without delivering possession to the creditor. It includes the stated floating-charge and crystallisation situation. The fact that the borrower continues using the goods therefore does not by itself disprove the hypothecation.

Do not merge this with a pledge merely because both involve movables. The SARFAESI section 31(b) exclusion expressly concerns pledge of movables within section 172 of the Contract Act. A valid security may have a remedy under another legal framework while being excluded from this Act. Exclusion from SARFAESI is not a declaration that the underlying pledge is void.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a pledge exclusion mean that every valid pledge debt is cancelled?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Act applicability and the validity or other remedies of a pledge are different questions.

payload.stem_md: A borrower retains possession of charged stock under an established hypothecation. The officer says retention of possession automatically destroys the charge. What is the error?

options.text_md: Hypothecation always requires the creditor to hold physical possession
options.explanation_md: The definition expressly describes security without delivery to the creditor.

options.text_md: Stock can never be movable property
options.explanation_md: Ordinary stock can be movable property under the stated scenario.

options.text_md: Hypothecation is defined without delivery of possession to the creditor
options.explanation_md: Borrower possession alone is consistent with that security form.

options.text_md: Every movable charge must be an outright sale
options.explanation_md: A charge does not automatically become a sale.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Borrower possession alone is consistent with that security form.

payload.stem_md: An established pledge of movables falls within Contract Act section 172. What does SARFAESI section 31(b) require the analyst to distinguish?

options.text_md: Exclusion from this Act from any separate valid pledge remedy
options.explanation_md: The exclusion does not itself cancel the underlying pledge or its separate remedies.

options.text_md: Exclusion from this Act means every obligation has been paid
options.explanation_md: Statutory applicability is not evidence of repayment.

options.text_md: Pledge is automatically converted to hypothecation
options.explanation_md: An exclusion does not reclassify the security form.

options.text_md: The creditor may ignore the exclusion after marking NPA
options.explanation_md: Asset classification does not repeal the express statutory exclusion.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The exclusion does not itself cancel the underlying pledge or its separate remedies.
